description: This file defines schemas and validation logic for annotation layer annotations in the Superset project, including JSON validation, schema classes for POST and PUT requests, and API method overrides.

classes.name: AnnotationPostSchema
classes.description: Schema for creating annotation layer annotations, including fields for description, start/end datetime, and JSON metadata.

classes.name: AnnotationPutSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating annotation layer annotations with optional fields.

methods.name: validate_json
methods.description: Validates that the input JSON string or bytes is valid JSON, raises ValidationError if invalid.
